claims.evidence: The witness report describes the console as having three layers, which is the specific physical design of the PS4 Pro model.
Subjective performance and software-side enhancements cannot be confirmed through static photos.

risks.risk: The console may have a 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD) or other motherboard failures.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting from a cold start to the main PlayStation dashboard.

risks.risk: The internal Blu-ray disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The internal hard drive may be the base 1TB or have bad sectors.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Information' screen showing the total storage capacity.

risks.risk: The controllers may suffer from stick drift or failed internal batteries.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers being used to navigate the UI without erratic movement.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of a game disc being inserted and loaded.
Screenshot of the 'Settings > System > System Information' menu.
Photos of the rear ports to check for HDMI or power socket damage.
response.reason: The item is identified as a PS4 Pro Star Wars edition with confirmed cosmetic wear. It is priced as a non-functional unit until power and disc drive operations are verified.
